COPILOT_HOME alone moves only the state (config.json, logs, session-state/<id>/{events.jsonl,checkpoints,workspace.yaml,rewind-file-snapshots}, session-store.db) while ~175 MB of cache and device ids still land under XDG_CACHE_HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME, so config-env alone would write to the real home.

notes: Turn: `copilot -p "reply with OK" --model auto --auto-tier efficiency -s --no-auto-update` (gpt-5-mini was rejected as not available for this account; auto/efficiency routed to mai-code-1.1-flash). Each successful turn is 1 premium request; 8 successful turns were run over the iterations, about $0.32 at the $0.04 list price (quota, not billed per call; copilot reports no USD).

Auth fails (exit 1, "No authentication information found") with only a temp HOME and no credentials, and also with hosts.yml staged but `gh` absent from PATH; it works with hosts.yml symlinked into XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gh AND the gh binary directory on PATH. The staged hosts.yml is a symlink to the real file (hash unchanged after the run).
First use in a fresh home self-extracts the CLI package into XDG_CACHE_HOME/copilot/pkg (~175 MB, 220 files); pass --no-auto-update (or COPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE=false) so a role never downloads updates.
The runner (copilot-runner.ts) sets no env and honours COPILOT_CLI_BIN only.
